About The Role The Digital Factory CMES Tester / Developer is responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality, and reliability of MES applications by executing comprehensive testing across the full lifecycle. This role works closely with developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to validate system behavior, ensure alignment with business requirements, and support high-quality, defect-free releases, while contributing to continuous improvement and test automation initiatives. Key Responsibilities As a Digital Factory CMES Tester / Developer , you’ll be responsible for: Translating business requirements and user stories into structured test scenarios, cases, and scripts Developing and maintaining test plans, traceability matrices, and validation strategies Executing end-to-end testing across multiple phases, including unit validation, SIT, regression, UAT support, and performance testing Validating system functionality, data integrity, integrations, and business workflows Performing integration testing across MES, ERP systems (e.g., SAP), and external platforms Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects, ensuring proper prioritization and resolution Collaborating with development teams to validate fixes and ensure successful retesting Supporting business users during UAT, including environment setup, test data, and issue resolution Contributing to automated testing frameworks and continuous integration practices Maintaining testing documentation, reports, defect logs, and dashboards Identifying gaps in testing coverage and driving improvements in quality processes Participating in Agile ceremonies, retrospectives, and continuous improvement initiatives Requirements We are looking for people who are detail-oriented, analytical, proactive, and quality-driven, with strong collaboration and problem-solving skills . If this is you, get in touch. As a Minimum You Must Have Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field Strong understanding of software testing lifecycle (STLC) 3+ years of experience in functional testing, integration testing (SIT), and UAT support Experience with regression testing and defect management processes Experience with SQL and data validation, as well as API/integration testing Experience using defect tracking tools such as Jira or similar Familiarity with Agile methodologies and sprint-based delivery Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams Advanced English (written and spoken) Although not necessary, it would be nice if you have: Understanding of MES systems and manufacturing processes Experience working in multi-system integration environments Exposure to test automation frameworks Exposure to performance testing tools Benefits We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way. Join us and make a difference. Apply Now! Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. Title: SR Windchill Engineer
Description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description Position Summary Rockwell Automation is in the process of implementing the Windchill solution as a new corporate-wide PLM platform. If you're interested in joining a newly formed and growing team, please apply for this role. This position is part of the global IT Product Lifecycle Management team. As a SR Windchill Engineer at Rockwell Automation, you will be responsible for leading the functional design, configuration, and delivery of Windchill capabilities across the enterprise. You’ll collaborate with business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners to ensure the platform meets evolving business needs and drives operational excellence. Your Responsibilities Lead functional design and configuration of Windchill modules including Part, BOM, Document, CAD, and Change Management. Translate business requirements into scalable Windchill solutions and functional specifications. Contribute to the Windchill functional roadmap and ensure alignment with enterprise PLM strategy. Collaborate with product owners as well developers, and architects to deliver end-to-end solutions. Conduct workshops and working sessions with business teams to gather requirements and validate solutions. Provide guidance and mentorship to other functional analysts and support team Manage individual enhancement requests, defects, and backlog items using Agile tools like Jira, Azure DevOps etc. Participate in SAFe ceremonies (daily synchs, sprint planning, backlog grooming). Ensure documentation of functional designs, configurations, and process flows. The Essentials - You Will Have Bachelor’s or Associate degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (completed or nearing completion). 7+ years of experience in Windchill functional roles, including configuration and business analysis. Deep understanding of PLM/Windchill capabilities and configuration elements (ACLs, OIRs, lifecycles, workflows, types, attributes). Proven experience in translating business needs into Windchill solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and enterprise DevOps practices. Fluent in English (C1). The Preferred - You Might Also Have Experience working in a global multi-language environment with distributed teams. Exposure to ticketing tools like ServiceNow. Experience with Windchill upgrades and integrations with ERP or CAD systems. Modality: Hybrid You will report to: Technical Leader What We Offer Our benefits package includes … Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm. Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees. Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. Employee Assistance Program. Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!
